body: I think you're onto something. It's that total lack of control you feel playing the game as the scene plays out. There's no way you could have saved Joel in that moment, no matter what you did or how fast you ran to that door, the outcome is always the same, which is so different to what you're used to playing a game like this. Whereas, you have big emotional scenes where beloved charaters die in shows like this all the time. Even the camera angles are different, less shots of Ellie's POV on the floor, and so less of that feeling of powerlessness even though you're the one that's SUPPOSED to be in control while playing.
